title: Tax Invoice
key_sentences: Two 40-foot high-cube containers of machine parts sailed from Felixstowe on 9 March 2027 aboard the vessel Meridian Crest.
The charges below cover the door-to-port leg and the ocean voyage to Jebel Ali.
Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
Please quote the invoice number on every remittance so that we can allocate it promptly.
Zero-rated items relate to the international carriage of goods and the services directly linked to it.
Late payments may attract interest at 4% above the base rate.

notes: Single page. The dark letterhead band (organisation name, address, VAT line) is furniture, not a heading. "BILL TO" and "INVOICE DETAILS" are box labels, not headings. The two boxes sit side by side; reading order is box by box (bill-to address first, then the invoice-details key/value table). Line-item description cells 1 and 3 are two lines (joined with a space). Subtotal, VAT and total rows are rows of the same table, their label cell spanning six columns (repeated in each covered grid cell). Bank details are a second key/value table with no header row, laid out as two label/value pairs per row (four columns). The organisation name in the band is letter-spaced.
